test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Pawan said, “I am preparing hot coffee for you.”

options.text: Pawan said that he was preparing hot coffee for me.
Pawan had said that he was preparing hot coffee for me.
Pawan has said that he was preparing hot coffee for me.
Pawan says that he was preparing hot coffee for me.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Pawan said that he was preparing hot coffee for me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When reporting someone's speech in indirect speech, the tense of the verb usually changes to reflect the time of reporting.
 
• In this case, "**am**" changes to "**was**" because the reporting is happening in the past.
 
• "**For you**" changes to "**for me**" to reflect the change in perspective from the speaker to the reporter.
 
• The sentence could also be written as "Pawan said that he was preparing hot coffee for me."

 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2**: Changes the tense correctly but adds "had" unnecessarily.
 
• **Option 3**: Uses present perfect tense incorrectly and changes the perspective to the present instead of the past.
 
• **Option 4**: Uses present tense incorrectly and changes the perspective to the present instead of the past.
